   <div id="docSubImgWrapper" data-setting="userPref-viewMode-pub-sjj-systemPreferred-html">

<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="themeScrp">(<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19139000-19139024" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/139/#v19139001-v19139024" target="_blank">Psalm 139</a>)</p>
<div class="bodyTxt">
<ol class="source">
<li>
<p id="p4" data-pid="4" class="p4 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">1. </span>O God, you know my rest and waking,</p>
<p id="p5" data-pid="5" class="p5 sz">When I lie down and when I rise anew.</p>
<p id="p6" data-pid="6" class="p6 sp">You search my thoughts, my inmost inclination,</p>
<p id="p7" data-pid="7" class="p7 sz">The words I speak, the ways I walk,</p>
<p id="p8" data-pid="8" class="p8 sz">you know them too.</p>
<p id="p9" data-pid="9" class="p9 sp">You saw when I was made in secret,</p>
<p id="p10" data-pid="10" class="p10 sz">My very bones not hidden from your sight.</p>
<p id="p11" data-pid="11" class="p11 sp">You saw my form; its parts were down in writing.</p>
<p id="p12" data-pid="12" class="p12 sz">I love the wonder of your ways</p>
<p id="p13" data-pid="13" class="p13 sz">and praise your might.</p>
<p id="p14" data-pid="14" class="p14 sp">Your knowledge, God, is wondrous, awe-inspiring;</p>
<p id="p15" data-pid="15" class="p15 sz">Of this my soul is very well-aware.</p>
<p id="p16" data-pid="16" class="p16 sp">If I should fear that darkness might enfold me,</p>
<p id="p17" data-pid="17" class="p17 sz">Your spirit, God, would find me, even there.</p>
<p id="p18" data-pid="18" class="p18 sp">Where could I hide from you, Jehovah,</p>
<p id="p19" data-pid="19" class="p19 sz">Or be concealed, be hidden from your face?</p>
<p id="p20" data-pid="20" class="p20 sp">Not in the Grave nor in the highest heaven,</p>
<p id="p21" data-pid="21" class="p21 sz">Not in the dark nor in the sea;</p>
<p id="p22" data-pid="22" class="p22 sz">there is no place.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="closingContent">
<p id="p23" data-pid="23" class="p23 se">(See also <a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19066003" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/66/#v19066003" target="_blank">Ps. 66:3;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19094019" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/94/#v19094019" target="_blank"> 94:19;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="24017010" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/jeremiah/17/#v24017010" target="_blank"> Jer. 17:10</a>.)</p>
</div>
<p id="p24" class="displayNone"> </p>
